method: Static inspection of official Darwin arm64 and Linux x64 package/claude files. Hashes match dist-inventory.json. No downloaded executable was run.
safe_mode_option_description_parts: Start with all customizations (CLAUDE.md, skills, installed plugins, hooks, MCP servers, custom commands and agents, output styles, workflows, custom themes, keybindings, and more) disabled
\u2014 useful for troubleshooting a broken configuration.
Admin-managed (policy) settings still apply. Auth, model selection, built-in tools and plugins, and permissions work normally. Sets CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE=1.

claude_platform.reason: The plugin's isAvailable still begins with the launch interactivity getter and then requires the dynamic flag. Both routes pass -p, which the print detector makes non-interactive and stores as isInteractive false. The builtin availability filter skips the plugin before adding its MCP server; mayConnectMcpServer also rechecks isAvailable. Response-only safe mode independently blocks mcpAutoDiscovered and rejects nonempty init MCP.

interactivity_bookkeeping.reason: The launch path still sets interactivity from the same print detector before builtin plugin selection. The added decided flag records that the setter ran; it does not change the stored value or the availability gate.
